label: exploratory
question: Mean token log-probability and Min-20% token log-probability of the original unmasked stem plus options, scored with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on GPU.
text: Original stem, blank line, then lettered options in original order. No chat template and no masking instruction. This is the text as it would appear in a released exam PDF.
scoring: Causal next-token log-softmax over the tokenized online text. Mean is the average log-probability of tokens 1..n-1. Min-20% is the mean of the lowest ceil(0.20 * n) token log-probabilities.
